Riff 0.6.35 draws the Flip mark on all artwork.

Covers, the immersive view, the image export and exported videos carry the Flip face followed by "flip." at the lower left. The Mark control that 0.6.34 added to the Shape & light panel is removed, and a mark saved by 0.6.34 has no effect. A video export draws the mark on every frame.

Updates keep the library, recordings, saved material and settings in the persistent workspace. Verified model downloads are reused; source installations may rebuild a changed engine. Music, writing, reviews and exports must finish or be cancelled before activation.
